title: "Billboard scrape post office"
output: html_document
date: "2026-11-11"
---

##load packages
```{r}
library(rvest)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(stringr)
```

##Generate Chart Dates
```{r}
chart_dates <- seq.Date(
  from = as.Date("1990-01-06"),
  to = as.Date("2026-11-07"),
  by = "week"
)

chart_dates <- format(chart_dates, "%Y-%m-%d")

length(chart_dates)
```

## Create Scrape
```{r}
scrape_billboard <- function(date) {

# weekly chart URL
  url <- paste0(
    "https://www.billboard.com/charts/hot-100/",
    date, "/"
  )

  page <- rvest::read_html(url)

# Extract titles
  titles <- page |>
    rvest::html_elements(
      "li.o-chart-results-list__item h3#title-of-a-story"
    ) |>
    rvest::html_text2()

# Extract names
  artists <- page |>
    rvest::html_elements(
      "li.o-chart-results-list__item h3#title-of-a-story + span"
    ) |>
    rvest::html_text2()

# Confirm chart has 100 entries
  if (length(titles) != 100 ||
      length(artists) != 100) {
    stop("Chart did not return 100 songs")
  }

# Create dataframe
  data.frame(
    chart_date = as.Date(date),
    chart_position = 1:100,
    song_title = titles,
    artist_name = artists
  )
}
```

## Identify if weeks are missing + folders
```{r}

# Create folders
dir.create("data/raw",
           recursive = TRUE,
           showWarnings = FALSE)

dir.create("data/processed",
           recursive = TRUE,
           showWarnings = FALSE)

# Identify charts not saved
remaining_dates <- chart_dates[
  !file.exists(
    paste0(
      "data/raw/billboard_",
      chart_dates,
      ".csv"
    )
  )
]

# Count remaining charts
length(remaining_dates)

# Display first five remaining dates
head(remaining_dates, 5)
```

## The actual scrape DO NOT TOUCH
```{r}

# Scrape all remaining Billboard charts
# Run only after access permission is established

for (i in seq_along(remaining_dates)) {

  date <- remaining_dates[i]

  # Try to scrape this week
  weekly_data <- tryCatch(
    scrape_billboard(date),
    error = function(e) {
      message("Failed: ", date)
      NULL
    }
  )

  # Save successful charts
  if (!is.null(weekly_data)) {

    readr::write_csv(
      weekly_data,
      paste0(
        "data/raw/billboard_",
        date,
        ".csv"
      )
    )

    message("Saved: ", date)
  }

# Pause before the next website request
  if (i < length(remaining_dates)) {
    Sys.sleep(10)
  }
}
```

## Combine the charts
```{r}
# Find all saved weekly CSV files
files <- list.files(
  "data/raw",
  pattern = "^billboard_[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}\\.csv$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

# Combine charts into one dataframe
billboard_data <- files |>
  lapply(readr::read_csv,
         show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  dplyr::bind_rows()

# Sort the dataset
billboard_data <- billboard_data |>
  dplyr::arrange(chart_date, chart_position)

# Save final dataset
readr::write_csv(
  billboard_data,
  "data/processed/billboard_combined.csv"
)

# View results
nrow(billboard_data)
View(billboard_data)
```
